description.value: A BC Parks heritage site and conservancy on the northern tip of Graham Island, Haida Gwaii, directly west of Old Massett and Masset. The area holds deep Haida cultural significance with 32 archaeological sites, numerous culturally modified trees, shell middens, and plank house remains, plus a Haida Watchmen camp at George Point in Naden Harbour. It also provides important habitat for Northern goshawks, marbled murrelets, and common murres.
